name: program-clerk
description: Connects Claude Code to your Program Clerk account: notes your agents share across projects, machines, and sessions, leases that keep two agents out of one checkout, and handoffs between them.

key.title: Program Clerk key
key.description: An API key from your account's Keys page. The plugin's MCP tools need it. The hooks read it too, or the PROGRAM_CLERK_KEY environment variable when it is empty.
